items.name: Soothing Tonic
items.description: A weak but stable draught made from restorative residue.

effects.description: Gives a lighter restorative lift.

items.name: Healing Draught
items.description: A reliable restorative made from common valley herbs.

effects.description: Restores the body and steadies the nerves.

items.name: Echo Healing Draught
items.description: A healing draught with a softer second pulse worked into it.

effects.description: Restores more vitality in an echoed wave.

items.name: Field Poultice
items.description: A rough sun-and-meadow salve that closes up the scrapes a work crew earns in a day.

effects.description: Eases minor hurts and takes the sting out of tired hands.

items.name: Calmleaf Infusion
items.description: A quiet green infusion brewed for people who have forgotten how to sleep.

effects.description: Loosens a clenched jaw and lets a racing head settle.

items.name: Verdant Restorative
items.description: A deep-green tonic that coaxes vigor back into tired bodies and tired beds alike.

effects.description: Restores a solid measure of vitality and steadies growth.

items.name: Bloomrise Elixir
items.description: A refined restorative that wakes dormant roots and thin bodies in one long green pulse.

effects.description: Pours a lasting bloom of vitality into whatever drinks it.

items.name: Greenmend Salve
items.description: A cool, clean salve tuned for wilted planter beds and delicate specimens.

effects.description: Feeds tired roots and settles skittish growth.

items.name: Purified Draught
items.description: A clean, exacting restorative prized by buyers who pay for a flawless pour.

effects.description: Restores vitality with an unusually clean finish.

items.name: Wellspring Elixir
items.description: A masterwork-grade restorative, the sort of pour a town remembers.

effects.description: Floods the body with clean, lasting vitality.

items.name: Moonmoth Salve
items.description: A restorative that leaves a faint moth-light halo, easy on frightened patients at night.

effects.description: Restores vitality with a calming glow.
Sheds a brief, soothing light.

items.name: Kindling Tonic
items.description: A warm hearth-tonic that puts heat back into cold hands on an autumn morning.

effects.description: Restores warmth and a little vigor against the cold.

items.name: Nightglass Lantern
items.description: The desert's own lantern. Starlight settles the mixture until the glass keeps a cold, tireless flame.

effects.description: Holds a cold, near-inexhaustible light through a whole night route.
Eases the chill that comes with walking the dunes after dark.

items.name: Mirrorsalt Draught
items.description: Salt-pan flake cut with reedflower, clean enough that the town's water carriers drink it straight.

effects.description: Restores vitality and clears the grit of a long dry route.

items.name: Wardfrost Tonic
items.description: Cold ward frost carried in quietbloom. Brewed entirely from things the tower grew for itself.

effects.description: Restores deeply and leaves the drinker unusually settled.

items.name: Clearspring Draught
items.description: The plainest recipe in the book, taken as far as it goes. Starlight settles the healing draught until nothing is left in it but the mending.

effects.description: Restores fully and cleanly, with none of the heaviness a strong draught usually carries.

items.name: Deeproot Tonic
items.description: Restorative held under stillwater until it works slowly. Brin swears a bed fed with this is still answering a season later.

effects.description: Restores deeply and keeps working long after it is taken.

items.name: Hushwater Draught
items.description: Ward frost and quietbloom put under a stillwater pearl. The result is so quiet that Lyra will not keep an open bottle near the habitats.

effects.description: Restores completely and leaves the drinker unnervingly calm.

items.name: Fieldwide Poultice
items.description: A poultice thrown wide instead of applied. Weaker on any one person and far better across a work crew that all came off the same field.

effects.description: Treats broadly rather than deeply.

items.name: Second Spring Tonic
items.description: A restorative coiled into itself by an echo rune, so the bed it is worked into answers once now and once again a fortnight later.

effects.description: Restores, and then restores again once the first has worn through.

items.name: Hearthward Infusion
items.description: Calmleaf turned inward by a ward rune. It settles the drinker rather than the room, which is the harder of the two and the one people actually ask for.

effects.description: Settles and restores the drinker alone, without spending anything on the air.

items.name: Hollowroot Cordial
items.description: Pale violet and slightly dusty, and the only bottle in the valley whose ingredient list includes something that had stopped existing.

effects.description: Restores completely, with a depth nothing currently growing in the valley can match.

items.name: Hollowroot Reliquary
items.description: Starlight holds the cordial at the moment it finishes. Ione has one on a shelf and has not written a label for it, which for her is an enormous statement.

effects.description: Restores completely and does not fade the way a brew is supposed to.
Carries a faint violet reading-light of its own.

items.name: Stillkeeper Tonic
items.description: Cold, clear and entirely unhurried. It settles whatever takes it rather than mending anything, which for a frightened animal is the same thing.

effects.description: Restores slowly and completely, and takes the panic out of the taker.

items.name: Deepkeeper Draught
items.description: Stillwater held at ward temperature until the whole mixture forgets it was ever stirred. Only the cold bench can hold it long enough.

effects.description: Restores fully and leaves the taker steady for the rest of the day.

items.name: Terracemend Salve
items.description: A pale violet salve for neglected ground. It works slowly and asks to be left alone, which is exactly the complaint Brin has about it.

effects.description: Restores steadily and keeps holding, in soil or in people.

items.name: Hollow Hearth Tonic
items.description: Dark, smoky and unreasonably warming. The kind of thing you hand somebody who has been outside since before it was light.

effects.description: Restores solidly and puts heat back into whoever takes it.

items.name: Sluicewater Tonic
items.description: Clear, mineral and faintly cold. It tastes like the smell of a wet quarry, which is less unpleasant than it sounds and is the reason the road crews ask for it by name.

effects.description: Restores well and settles the grit out of a working day.

items.name: Openfield Draught
items.description: Green, grassy and unremarkable, and the first thing a great many alchemists in this valley ever brewed that actually worked.

effects.description: Restores steadily, with none of the heaviness of a stronger draught.
